title: LoomSurrealCoreParityClosureGate
clause: Prove complete Loom core semantic parity on SurrealDB and close all legacy database authority paths before module integrations proceed.

current_source_discovery: Resolve every MT-381 parity row to accepted implementation and proof from MT-382 through MT-391.
Independently inspect the exact runtime, UI, database, test and manual artifacts before verdict.
stop_conditions: Any MT-381 parity row is missing, deferred without authority or supported only by mock/legacy proof.
PostgreSQL/SQLite database authority or unclassified direct adapter remains.

scope.summary: Independent closure gate for Loom core. It proves Handshake's connected IDE/creative knowledge substrate is semantically restored on real SurrealDB before Notes and CKC integration families build on it.
forbidden_paths: Future Tailor or Studio feature implementation
acceptance_criteria: Every MT-381 capability row has an accepted implementation, real-Surreal proof, native UI proof when visible, manual entry and independent verdict.
A fresh Handshake runtime creates, links, searches, organizes, visualizes, exports, restarts and repairs representative Loom content with only SurrealDB available.
Cross-project private/shared, revocation, derived-scope and metadata-side-channel matrices pass using authenticated record users.
Independent source, dependency and runtime scans find no unclassified PostgreSQL, PgPool, SQLx-Postgres or SQLite Loom authority/fixture/proof path.
Failure injection proves EventLedger atomicity, live-query reconnect, index/projection reconciliation and canonical reread recovery.
proof_targets: Run the complete Loom real-Surreal integration suite from a fresh database through restart and repair.
Run independent forbidden-dependency and parity-matrix closure validators.
Run complete native Argus/UserManual no-context workflow and privacy matrices.

resources_touched: all Loom canonical and derived resources
same_project_private_resource_cases: Full representative workflow proves private resources remain isolated inside a shared project.
cross_account_negative_cases: All forged selectors, routes, relations, cursors and handles fail closed.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Every index, graph result, preview, export, event and diagnostic inherits source-scope intersection.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Concurrent revocation/context switch invalidates every stale Loom consumer.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote sources never create local authority automatically.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: complete typed Loom event and replay coverage
complete health, failure and repair taxonomy

risk_if_missed: Integration work can build on another superficially renamed but semantically incomplete Loom foundation.

risks: Parity is declared from file presence rather than runtime behavior.
Legacy tests pass without real SurrealDB.
An obscure adapter preserves second authority.

sources: Official SurrealDB documentation used by MT-382 through MT-391
research_provenance.selected_approach: Independent semantic parity closure against real SurrealDB and the complete operator-approved capability matrix.
